corrections: Translated all sixteen movie-invitation state and response strings directly from English, including Sandy, Dwarf, Krobus, Wizard, rude and child voices.
Applied locked Киносалон terminology and Sandy’s established gender-neutral „миличко“ address while keeping all dynamic-NPC and player wording free of unsupported grammatical gender.

Reread invitation ownership, weekly viewing limits, festival and closing states, ticket requirement and every acceptance or refusal; preserved both placeholders, Krobus’s dialogue break and Sandy’s source double space.
